title: CVLUE: A New Benchmark Dataset for Chinese Vision-Language Understanding Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on a newly curated benchmark dataset (CVLUE) featuring images and object categories representative of Chinese culture, and comparing their performance on Chinese-specific categories (e.g., Chinese shadow play, Hanfu) versus Western-centric categories (e.g., those overlapping with MS-COCO).

Comparing VLM performance on the original Chinese text prompts against text translated into English (using GPT-4) to isolate whether model performance gaps stem from a lack of cultural visual knowledge or a lack of Chinese language comprehension.
